entities.name: HIV-1 Nef
observations: The 203-aa query matches reviewed HIV-1 Nef proteins at 83.6–85.3% identity with 100% query coverage.
Curated Nef annotations describe down-regulation of host CD4 and MHC molecules and increased viral infectivity; localization includes the cytoplasmic face of host membranes and Golgi.
Query-derived estimates: 23,156.9 Da molecular mass, pI 5.91, and GRAVY −0.635; F-protein Pfam domain detected at residues 2–203.
